content.text: Let me try again with a more concise note:

input.note: The ledger-export cronjob is timing out due to an insufficient activeDeadlineSeconds value of 3600 seconds (1 hour). The job processes 9.4M ledger rows in 95 batches, requiring more time than allowed. Both recent failures show SIGTERM at exactly 1 hour with job status "DeadlineExceeded" [cite: concepts/workloads/controllers/job#job-termination-and-cleanup-1]. Fix: Increase activeDeadlineSeconds in the cronjob spec to 5400+ seconds (1.5+ hours) to allow the export to complete.
